page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.4xlarge belongs to the Local SSDs instance family, configured to serve I/O-intensive workloads requiring direct-attached fast storage. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs coupled with 64.0 GB of memory, delivering a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A defining hardware characteristic of the ecs.i4g.4xlarge is its bundled local storage array, comprising 959 GB of dedicated solid-state drive (SSD) capacity. This local SSD architecture eliminates network-attached storage latency overhead, providing direct low-latency read and write capabilities. In terms of external connectivity, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring VPC routing or elastic IP attachment for external reachability. There are no discrete GPUs configured on this node.

By combining a balanced general-purpose compute-to-memory profile with integrated high-speed local SSD storage, the ecs.i4g.4xlarge offers efficiency for data-heavy operations without relying on standalone network storage provisioning. The primary operational tradeoff involves managing ephemeral local data persistence, which requires application-level replication or secondary backup configurations. This server configuration is suitable for transactional databases, NoSQL engines, distributed caching nodes, real-time log analytics, and search indexing clusters requiring dedicated CPU cores and immediate local disk throughput.
description: The Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.4xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance from the Local SSDs family, engineered for I/O-sensitive operations requiring dedicated compute and integrated storage. Running on the KVM hypervisor, it features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz alongside 64.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Storage is provided via a bundled 959 GB local solid-state drive (SSD), which facilitates high-throughput, low-latency disk operations directly on the host. Networking capabilities include a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included and no GPU acceleration present. Given its combined hardware profile of dedicated cores and low-latency local SSD capacity, the instance is suitable for transactional databases, distributed NoSQL stores, search indexing nodes, and real-time analytical processing environments.
